summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing for iteration 19 UI changes: (1) Brand mark removal, (2) Floating Connect button border + pulse animation, (3) Desktop nav rail collapsible selector redesign. All requested features verified and working correctly.
passed_tests: Brand mark element (data-testid=site-header-brand) successfully removed - no floating 'Bretton J. Key' text in top-left area
Floating Connect button has visible 2px border (white/70 on dark, blue/60 on light backgrounds)
Floating Connect button pulse animation working (data-testid=floating-connect-button-pulse, animate-ping, 2.4s infinite)
Pulse element has pointer-events: none and does not block button clicks
Connect button remains fully clickable and opens ConnectForm dialog correctly
Connect button color swap mechanism working (adapts border/bg colors based on background theme)
Desktop nav rail (data-testid=site-desktop-nav) starts in collapsed state (data-expanded=false)
Nav rail collapsed state: only active section label visible, all other labels hidden (opacity 0)
Nav rail expands on mouse hover: glass panel (data-testid=site-nav-rail-panel) fades in (opacity 0→1)
Nav rail expanded state: all 12 nav item labels animate into view with glass panel background
Hover highlight pill (data-testid=site-nav-hover-highlight) appears and animates smoothly between items using framer-motion layoutId
Nav rail collapses when mouse leaves: glass panel fades out (opacity 1→0), labels hide
Clicking nav items triggers smooth Lenis scroll to corresponding sections
Active marker (aria-current=true) and underline correctly reflect current scroll position
Keyboard accessibility: Tab focus expands nav rail (data-expanded=true)
Arrow Up/Down keys navigate between nav items correctly (handleRailKeyDown working)
Nav rail collapses on blur when focus leaves the rail
Desktop quick-actions capsule (data-testid=site-quick-actions) visible and functional
Mobile hamburger nav trigger (data-testid=site-mobile-nav-trigger) works correctly
Mobile nav drawer (data-testid=site-mobile-nav-drawer) opens/closes with all nav items and quick actions
Desktop nav hidden on mobile viewport (390x844), mobile nav visible
Calendly schedule button exists in quick actions (data-testid=site-quick-action-schedule-call)
No console errors on page load
All expandable elements on page functional (22 found)
